summary: Iter 342 (Touchpoints ghost-task fix + Sold wizard scheduled sends + Wallet guards): Backend 4/4 pytest tests pass. Frontend sold-quick success screen renders 'JESSI IS HANDLING THESE' header with Contact card VCF (Sent), Digital card link and Review request rows both showing 'Sending h:mm PM' in gold, plus the 'These go out on their own...' hint and Done button. /touchpoints after the flow shows 0 tasks in All/Overdue - no ghost 'Send SMS' task for the QA Sold Tester direct sends. Backend guards for wallet return 200 {apple:false,google:false}, 503, 503 as spec'd. Endpoint /api/messages/scheduled/{uid}/{cid} works and enforces 403 for other user and 401 anon. Self-heal test confirmed both completed_via='auto_sent' (automated + status sent) and completed_via='send_cancelled' (manual + status cancelled) after waiting the 90s per-user catchup throttle.

minor.issue: Docstring says throttle is 2 minutes but _CATCHUP_INTERVAL is 90 seconds - problem statement referenced 'once per 2 min'. Not functional-breaking, just docs.

ui_bugs.issue: React Native Web strips `data-testid` prop passed directly to TouchableOpacity and TextInput. Only the spread pattern used on sold-workflow-preview/open works (testID + {...({'data-testid':...} as any)}). Result: sold-handling-header, sold-handling-hint, sold-quick-done, sold-name, sold-phone, sold-vehicle-input, send-type-photo, send-type-card, sold-quick-send, sold-camera, sold-library, referral-search, congrats-text-input, sold-retake, sold-pick-library, sold-date-btn, sold-quick-back are NOT emitted as DOM data-testid attributes. Only 3 out of ~18 testids are actually queryable in DOM. ScheduledSendRow testids (scheduled-send-{id}, scheduled-send-body-{id}, scheduled-send-status-{id}) in components/sold/ScheduledSendsList.tsx are also NOT rendered (same root cause). UI text/functionality works but automated testability is broken.

router.back() fails on web when there is no history entry (console warning 'GO_BACK not handled by any navigator'). URL stays on /sold-quick. Should router.replace('/home') or router.push('/home') as fallback.
Repeating console errors: 'Unexpected text node:         . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' - stray whitespace between JSX children inside a <View>. Not blocking but noisy.

action_items: Fix data-testid rendering in app/sold-quick.tsx and components/sold/ScheduledSendsList.tsx: replace `data-testid="..."` prop with the working spread pattern used on sold-workflow-preview: `testID="foo" {...({ 'data-testid': 'foo' } as any)}` OR upgrade react-native-web / set up a babel plugin so that data-testid pass-through works globally. This affects ~18 testids across the sold flow and blocks automated FE testing.
Sold-quick Done: replace `router.back()` with `router.replace('/home')` (or check `router.canGoBack()` first) so pressing Done actually leaves the success screen on web.

Reconcile routers/tasks.py docstring vs constant: either update comment 'Throttle: only run catchup once per user per 5 minutes' (line 27) and the problem statement 'once per 2 min' to match _CATCHUP_INTERVAL = 90 seconds (line 29), or set the interval to match the docs.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/messages.py list_scheduled_messages filters by created_at >= now-48h but sends queued > 48h out won't show — acceptable given hours param up to 14 days.

routers/tasks.py _close_tasks_for_auto_sends only runs inside _catchup_overdue_campaign_tasks which is throttled to 90s per user. If a task is created outside of that window (edge case) it will not close for up to 90s — acceptable but worth noting.

React Native Web data-testid pass-through is a repeated issue across the codebase; consider a top-level fix (babel-plugin-react-native-web already passes testID → data-testid; verify RNWeb version and remove custom `data-testid=` overrides).

rca of the issue: N/A — features work correctly. Only issues found are (1) RN Web data-testid pass-through: <TouchableOpacity data-testid='x'> in RN Web renders <div ...> without the attribute unless spread ({...({'data-testid':'x'} as any)}) or the testID prop is used with a babel plugin that maps testID→data-testid. Fix: switch to spread pattern everywhere in sold-quick.tsx and ScheduledSendsList.tsx as already done on lines 612/615 of sold-quick.tsx. (2) Done button: router.back() no-ops when there's no back history (direct navigation via pushState) — use router.replace('/home').
